City are entering the unknown after Pep Guardiola's departure, while Liverpool are rebuilding under Andoni Iraola. A last-gasp Josko Gvardiol winner handed Enzo Maresca a 2-1 win in his first Premier League game in charge of City against Bournemouth and Liverpool also left it late to draw 2-2 with Newcastle. Jockeys' Championship leader Billy Loughnane takes the ride on Nogo's Dream , whose last success came back in June of last year. However, he bounced back to form when finishing second to an unexposed and progressive type last time at Sandown. The third in that contest went onto win well subsequently and everything is pointing towards a competitive showing from this lad, with Richard Hughes' charge now five pounds below his last winning mark South Shore has been rejuvenated since moving to sprint-training specialist Robert Cowell. With form figures reading 1122 since transferring from the Ruth Carr stable, he should prove tough to beat.
